scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n poi,gateway,navigation,translation,web,admin "npm run dev -w @tourism/poi-service" "npm run dev -w @tourism/api-gateway" "npm run dev -w @tourism/navigation-service" "npm run dev -w @tourism/translation-service" "npm run dev -w @tourism/user-web" "npm run dev -w @tourism/admin-web"
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate -w @tourism/poi-service && npm run db:migrate -w @tourism/translation-service && npm run db:short-ids
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:deployment && npm run build
scripts.audio:prepare-defaults: npm run content:prepare -w @tourism/translation-service -- vi en zh-CN
scripts.server:tunnel: docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yml -f infrastructure/docker/compose.server.yml --profile tunnel up -d cloudflared
scripts.server:tunnel:stop: docker compose --env-file .env -f infrastructure/docker/compose.yml -f infrastructure/docker/compose.server.yml --profile tunnel stop cloudflared
